status: source contract before new product-family implementation
scope: 12 unique direct name/value scope rows before any panel; all three companion CSV sources carry the identical scope
panel: Warehouse or Plant row, Batch row, Field axis, six unique field-role rows in any order, optional Item dimensions role, explicit End panel; one parent kind per report; each new panel must provide its own parent and batch rows
ownership: CSV repeats the parent literally for every active column. XLSX may instead have a single-row parent merge whose original anchor owns only the columns in its explicit interval. Every column in that interval must be active; there is no carry to the next column, across a spacer, or into another panel. Batch and axis keys are direct nonmerged cells per active column
spacers: Inactive separator columns must have no batch, parent, role value or stored payload; an empty axis is not permission to ignore financial cells
merges: Only parent value cells in that panel's first row may merge horizontally; original covered cells must have no payload including numeric zero, no formula, overlap, vertical or financial merge
identity: literal item, axis, parent and batch with leading zeros preserved; unique axes within a panel; unique item/derived-dimension tuple over the report; optional explicit dimensions must equal the independently source-derived pair
financial: provided posted carrying value only; exact BHD minor units (3 decimals) and independent quantity precision; mapping/evidence/GL membership comes from original companion cells and cannot be proved by a sum
controls: Report total is a supplied control over all parsed record values, never an extra record; End report required; missing zero is not explicit zero
errors: preserve the existing whole-stock source-error gate for malformed source; no partial-isolation, source rewriting, inferred valuation or AI approval

story.trap: A+B=C while A and C have the same literal item and batch but different warehouse and quantity unit. D and F have the same amount. Moving amounts or parent ownership can preserve the grand and account totals while producing the wrong branch membership.

structures: one horizontal axis with explicit repeated CSV parent cells
one horizontal axis under native XLSX merged parent intervals
stacked complete panels, reordered fields and explicit panel boundaries
stacked XLSX panels with inactive separator columns and shared-string cells
evidenceRequiredBeforeActivation: all 20 KWD scenarios completed with expected financial outcomes, including positive source achievement and negative membership/structure controls
parent anchor and exact merge interval
